Hi Meredith —

Quick intro — I’m David (Security & Compliance at Redwood Inference). We’re finalizing the Whistic onboarding for TruNorth so our SOC 2/CAIQ sync can point to your live profile. Two quick asks to make the profile upload smooth: 

1) Please add our public KMS key to your Whistic profile under “KMS / Key Exchange” so we can verify signed evidence bundles. I’ve attached the key (redwood_kms_pubkey.pem).

2) Can you upload a short sample of the S3 object audit log (redacted) used for evidence possession proofs? A tiny sample (5–10 lines) is perfect. We’ll use that only for proof-of-possession mapping in the CAIQ.

I’ve attached a CAIQ draft with our recommended mapping (column comments). If it’s easier, we can do a 30-minute grooming call to walk through mapping and permissions. Laura (cc’d) will coordinate timing.

High level: we want the Whistic profile to include: CAIQ answers draft, KMS public key uploaded, and a sample access log artifact so our portal ingest can validate the “evidence possession” steps before the SOC 2 review.

Thanks — if you prefer, reply with your portal admin’s email and we’ll send an invite.

-David
